feature: Floating core: the floor stays, the platform goes
gating: Run layers in order inside each checkpoint. Do not run a layer until every case of that checkpoint in the layer before it passes. No UI layer: the product has no UI (ui gate n/a in every checkpoint).
conventions: Unit: no network, no wall clock (inject the clock), temp roots under os.tmpdir(), env vars and cwd restored in afterEach.

Integration: real git in temp repos under os.tmpdir(), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM pointed at an empty file, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; every case proves its fixture premise (branch, HEAD, remote HEAD, sha, count) before asserting what the code derives from it (R5).

Contract: static checks only (schema, links, cited names, absence of literals, arch rules); never a phrase match standing in for behaviour (R1). Every extractor-based contract has a self-test fixture that must fail, so an empty extraction cannot pass vacuously (R3).
Refusals: assert the exact path and the runnable next command in the message, plus the exit code (6.6, P8, R2).
covers lists the brainstorm cases (S1-S18, F7) and guard rules (G1-G8) a case proves.

retention: a second trigger on the same (injected) day does no scan — stale files added after the first pass are still present; a trigger on the next day runs again
retention: one pass deletes at most the configured batch even when more stale receipts exist; summary.json and denies.json survive every pass with their contents unchanged

valid transitions (6.5): implementation→awaiting-app-review with all gates passed and full SHAs; request-changes→implementation clears both SHAs; approval→ready-to-merge; lost CAS invalidates review back to implementation with SHAs cleared; →blocked keeps earlier approvals; blocked→its previous phase

refused transitions: implementation before plan approval; skip to app review or ready-to-merge; app review with any gate not passed; request-changes keeping a SHA; approval that changes a SHA; ready-to-merge with app_review pending; writing complete; invalidation while reviewed_base is still the base tip

schema errors refused with the field named: missing checkpoints, empty or null checkpoint entries, checkpoint missing required fields, unknown gate status, non-finite id (1e999); slug different from the file name refused

brainstorm approval parser with an injected clock: matching ai-feature + ai-approved today + 'complete · <same date>' → approved; exactly 14 days → approved; 15 days → refused; other slug → refused; draft status → refused; complete line with a different date → refused; missing meta → refused

Write of a plan that fails the schema, or whose slug differs from its file name, is denied; a marker whose slug differs from the plan slug is denied; a non-finite predecessor id cannot bypass an open gate
an unreadable or malformed plan JSON on disk denies with the reason and the absolute path; a malformed prior plan (checkpoints [null], [], missing fields, wrong slug) cannot authorize plan approval

first plan write denied without a brainstorm, with a stale (15-day) brainstorm, with another slug's brainstorm, or with a draft status; a pending first write cannot self-authorize a later approval; a first plan omitting lifecycle or with contradictory initial lifecycle (app review pending/approved, SHAs set before review) is denied
a symlinked alias plan, a symlinked target file or a symlinked path component cannot initialize lifecycle (skipped with a printed reason where the OS denies symlink creation)
markers: #2 implement with #1 passed → allow; #3 while #2 open → deny; #1 already passed → deny; unknown #9 → deny; passed predecessor with an incomplete gate (with and without lifecycle) → deny
writes: marking #3 behavior passed while #2 open → deny; an Edit (old_string/new_string applied to the file on disk) setting #3 status passed while #2 open → deny; MultiEdit takes the same path
unknown stage → deny; ui marker before behavior passed → deny; review before behavior → deny; review with ui pending → deny; review with ui n/a → allow; writing ui passed before behavior → deny
status passed with any gate not passed or n/a → deny; all gates passed or n/a then status passed → allow; behavior failed write → allow

Bash writes to the plan JSON denied: heredoc redirection (>, >>), sed -i, tee, cp, mv, python3 -c open(...,'w'), and Git-prefixed compound commands with write-capable segments; Cursor's Shell tool is treated as Bash; git add and cat of the plan → allow

Stop: mid-checkpoint in the orchestrator session → deny; other session → allow; user_interrupt → allow; ask_user_question → allow; halted set → allow; all passed → allow; before any gate started → allow; invalid state written behind the hooks' back → deny
Stop loop limit: the same session is denied 3 times in a row then allowed (same MAX_STOP_BLOCKS as the Python gate); the counter is per session

outside the three triggers (Write/Edit of a checkpoints JSON, a [checkpoint slug#id stage] marker, Stop) the guard allows without reading: an unrelated Write and a plain prompt allow even while the plan JSON is unreadable
each refusal names the checkpoint, the gate and the next step (e.g. 'CP3 cannot pass: review is pending. Next: run the CP3 review.')
